method: One fresh local Chrome navigation per instrumented standalone page, same default viewport, no applied CPU/network throttling. DOMContentLoaded timing includes script execution and content construction, not paint. Browser tools only read DOM attributes written by a test-only head listener; instrumentation is absent from shipped assets.
limits: Single browser comparison, not a cross-device benchmark or percentile.
JavaScript bootstrap CI budget is 1500 ms; it excludes layout and paint.
No real-device touch or slow-phone measurement.
